#@ Corpus for hooks/tests/exec-boundary-oracle.js (run by exec-boundary-oracle.test.sh).
#@ Format: a header line `#@ <id> <expect>` followed by the raw command text up to the next header
#@ (the final newline of the block is not part of the command). expect = deny | allow | oracle.
#@ deny / allow: the hook verdict must be exactly that. oracle: no assertion beyond "no bypass".
#@ A header whose first word has no expect token is a comment (the lines of this preamble).
